name: Aldriak: The Advent of a New World
storyline:
Aldriak tells the story of the eponymous hero who finds himself in a fantasy world without understanding why.

When he is attacked by creatures, he is quickly rescued by two people who become his friends.

The game has two main themes that are explored throughout the story:
- Aldriak's desire to return home, to his world or dimension.
- His friends' desire to find a solution to the sacrifices that have been taking place for thousands of years in their world.
summary: It's a RPG turn-based strategy game inspired by the first games of the genre but with a new and original mechanic. This mechanic takes the form of 3 distinct rows in which all the fighters are placed. Each skill requires being in a particular row and can only target by following certain rules.
